title: Attack: a cross-model adversary for ledger entry UQ-20261030-07
statement: Across human one-to-many transmission clusters of an acute respiratory virus, what is the donor-level intraclass correlation of log10 transmission bottleneck size N_b - do the several recipients infected by one donor show correlated founding-population sizes, and what fraction of between-event variance in bottleneck width sits at the donor level?

inputs.read_only: the entry's fields from 'Question (canonical)' through the significance argument. Do NOT read its earlier adversary logs or verification notes before you finish: this unit exists to get an attack that was not anchored on them.
inputs.why: Provisional after three adversaries from one model family; a second family's attack is the cheapest independent check left.
